messages:
sophia.li: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem, want to lock owners and short timelines for remediation + capture recurring patterns so they are trackable.

noah.kim: +1. Also suggest an audit-event completeness SLO — last outage had ~12% missing delegated-token events.

owen.martin: I can own token validation hardening. Plan: canonicalize tokens, centralize expiry checks, add fuzz tests. ETA staging PR 2026-05-05.

sec-analyst: I'll produce a CSV of missing-event signatures from the incident dump and attach to the task.

sec-bot: Task created -> TASK-4921 (owner: owen.martin, due: 2026-05-05).

sophia.li: Owners/deliverables: (A) Token hardening = @owen.martin TASK-4921 (staging + canary by 2026-05-05); (B) Audit replay + CI gate = @noah.kim TASK-4922 (replay & unit test by 2026-05-10); (C) Secrets rotation telemetry + alerting = @sophia.li TASK-4923 (metrics + runbook by 2026-05-14). Confirm?

noah.kim: Confirmed. I'll run a replay over 90d of events and add a unit test that requires `auth.audit_event` for critical paths. Also proposing provisional SLO: 99.9% audit-event emission over 30d.

owen.martin: Token changes will be behind feature flag `authz.canonicalize_v2`. Canary: 5% traffic for 72h then ramp. Need a canary checklist; @sophia.li can you add?

sophia.li: Added canary checklist to TASK-4921: smoke, telemetry probes, sample logs retention. Also added label `authz-remediation` to tasks.

sec-analyst: Uploaded CSV: https://internal.redwood/secure/authz/missing-events-2026.csv. Key gaps in delegated flow between proxy and auth-service.

noah.kim: I'll use that CSV as ground truth for the replay. Also adding a nightly validator that scans stored tokens for non-canonical shapes and alerts >0.1% non-canonical.

sophia.li: New rule for runbooks: runbook updates must be in the same PR as the fix or include `docs-sync` label. This prevents drift.

owen.martin: Need masked old-format test vectors for unit tests. @sec-analyst can you add to TASK-4921?

sec-analyst: Done, vectors uploaded to secure path and linked in TASK-4921.

sec-bot: Recurring sync scheduled -> Fridays 09:00 (channel: #incidents, thread: 1810012345).

sophia.li: First check-in: 2026-04-28 10:00. Agenda: audit replay output, canary plan, metrics. I'll post a short status before meeting. Thanks. :thumbsup:

noah.kim: Ack.

owen.martin: Ack.
